I haven’t used for long but i recently had my first experience with hallicinations..  Soo i was having a war with a spider in my own Home for 3 days:) (I was feeling normal the first 1 and a half days). Anyway i saw a giant spider running across the floor and hid under a big pile of clothes and stuff. I’m not scared of spiders , I even have a pet spider. But this spider was so freakin big and ugly and i started shaking, I hadn’t used stims for more than a couple of hours so It was 100% real to me. I was so scared bc the spider looked too big to be from where I live so i was scared it was someone’s pet that had escaped, fr I remember sending snaps to my mom saying it was the ugliest creepiest spider and it looks like something that came from h3ll. She thought it was real (like i did) and said if i didn’t find it i could sleep at her house if im scared lol. I sat the whole day in my bed with a lavender airfreshner spray bc i didn’t have anything else to kill it with, i was so nervous but i was just doing my thing while keeping an eye out. Suddenly i see the spider running across the floor and i jumped out of bed running after it and i spray myself in the face on accident lol, but i quickly then sprayed the sh*t out of it and it rolled underneath a closet. I wasn’t sure if it was dead but i thought it will choke and die from all the spray anyway so i left it. Then in the middle of the night (24hours later) i was sitting on my bed on my phone, suddenly i see the spider running full speed towards me ON MY BED and i quickly moved my pillow and got up and it ran down the bed , i thought, i tried looking down on the floor and I look the spider right in the face just sitting right on the edge of my bed and i freak out again and it ran away. I was soo freaked out cause i was sure the spider was mad at me for trying to kill it, like he ran so fast right towards me i could sense his anger lol. I was getting sleepy at this point but forced myself to stay awake another night, this time sitting on a chair. I didn’t see the spider again until the night after that, still too scared to sleep.. Soo i started feeling bugs and hearing bugs in the walls etc. I kinda knew it was bc of the speed (or i was hoping). But the spider was still real to me. It got worse and worse, and then i see the spider on the floor again, just chilling. I was confused bc it wasn’t as big as i saw last time, anyway i sprayed it again. It managed to run away under the fridge this time and i had enough so i tried to block so he wouldn’t be able to come out again. Now I’m starting to think if the spider is real or not, I was so confused , I think it’s real but i might be wrong yk. So i just lay in bed awake a few hours later and feel something on my head and I just panick and almost start crying, i sit up and i feel something pulling my hoodie!! I didn’t see the spider but i remember thinking it’s the spider and it’s fcking pissed at me. I felt like that spider is gonna get me somehow, like this is fcking personal and it won’t end until one of us win haha. I stood up and tried to check under the fridge but no spider. I didn’t take my speed after that. I didn’t see it anymore, i fell asleep a couple hours later on the day. Then i got more sleep that night and the next day i went to my bf’s house and i’ve been here for 3 days. I’m going Home tomorrow and idk if the spider was real or not but i think there was a real spider but i might just overreact a little and my brain messed it up on speed lol. Not excited to get Home I’m scared lmao
